_schema.description: Machine-readable execution sequence for autonomous master-plan completion. This sidecar references canonical Oyatie plan/checklist primitives instead of duplicating them.
_schema.authority_note: Execution overlay only; docs/CONSTITUTION.md, docs/MASTERPLAN.md, ADRs, and checklist templates remain authoritative.

planning_hierarchy.milestone: multi-quarter outcome; M<NN>-slug; owns phase index and exit gate
planning_hierarchy.phase: 1-6 week deliverable; P<NN>-slug; owns entry/exit gates and dependency ordering
planning_hierarchy.implementation_plan: ChangeSet-sized executable phase-local slice; owns grit symbols, issue-level scope, code shape, tests, evidence, handoff, and promotion eligibility

repo_state_protocol.fallback: icm store -t scaffold-locks-oyatie only until P00 file/artifact claims are implemented

repo_state_protocol.primitive: edit only inside isolated claimed workspace
repo_state_protocol.fallback: stop and narrow claim on shared-symbol conflict

repo_state_protocol.primitive: run targeted then risk-scaled gates; package evidence into ChangeBundle
repo_state_protocol.fallback: record blocked check and next-best evidence

repo_state_protocol.primitive: done emits signed ChangeBundle and GitOps promotion request; local merge is compatibility-only
repo_state_protocol.fallback: do not manually merge; report blocked promotion

repo_state_protocol.primitive: GitOps controller owns remote ref/PR-equivalent publication, CI/CD admission, environment reconciliation, and lock release
repo_state_protocol.fallback: keep/release locks according to terminal policy; never agent-run git/gh

early_prerequisites.compatibility_window: Existing local grit may be used only until P00 reaches accepted GitOps promotion path.

implementation_plan_changeset_contract.definition: Every ImplementationPlan is a ChangeSet-sized execution unit. It must be claimable, independently verifiable, bundleable, promotable, and small enough to avoid locking an entire tree without graph-proven rationale.
split_when: multiple independently deployable packages without shared invariant
whole-tree rebuild without declared full-gate reason
mixed provider adapter and kernel work without explicit contract boundary
review/fix task independent from original ChangeSet
implementation_plan_changeset_contract.validation_lane: oya-foundry-fitness-plan-hierarchy + Oya VCS admission once M-CC-P00 is accepted
